ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.TEXT_1: What began as a spark of curiosity and a small first project quickly grew into a passion and a clear professional direction. With an inquisitive mindset and a place in a field that never stops evolving, I soon realized that programming wasn't just an interest - it was the path I wanted to pursue.
ABOUT.TEXT_2: Let's grow and create something Awesome together!

SKILLS.TITLE: Core Competencies
SKILLS.TEXT: I work across the full front-end stack — Angular and TypeScript for well-structured applications, JavaScript and CSS to bring designs to life, and Material Design for clean, user-friendly interfaces. I've used Supabase for real-time data and authentication, and I always back my work with GitHub. I care about the details that make an experience feel right: responsive layouts, fast load times, and interactions that just work.
SKILLS.GROWTH_TEXT: Currently something new sparked my Interest! I've switched to Linux and started learning Python!

PROJECTS.TITLE: My work
PROJECTS.SUBTITLE: Explore a selection of my work here - Interact with the projects to see my skills in action.
PROJECTS.EL_POLLO_LOCO: A simple Jump-and-Run game based on an object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to defeat his enemies and collect Coins.
PROJECTS.JOIN: A Task-manager inspired by the Kanban System created as a Group Project.
